content:
Before the iPod existed, the Sony Walkman was already the top choice for anyone who wanted to take their music on the go. Now the Duo-Man app recreates that experience, letting those of us who once owned a Walkman relive those glory days — you can even use it together with Apple Music……

Before the Walkman came along, people's options for listening to music on the street were extremely limited. Most cassette players at the time were big and bulky. Sony shrank a recorder originally designed for reporters down to the smallest size on the market — and it quickly became an iconic classic.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created this app at a hackathon. Since many people there had never actually seen a physical Walkman, he brought one along so everyone could see what it really looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album you want to put on the cassette, then close the lid, and the music starts playing.

Bhargava says he originally built this demo app just for fun, but has now decided to release it officially. The best reply under his X post is an image that only people of a certain age will truly understand.

What was your first music player? Share it in the comments.
